title: Raisable execution budget, ms overrun as a warning, translatable Retry
why: <meta budget> could not raise the B0910 ceilings (the compiler never passed it and the runtime clamped to the defaults), the non-fatal ms overrun looked like a fatal error in the dev overlay, and the fallback's Retry button was always in English.
changelog: now raises the B0910 execution ceilings
overruns (a diagnostic; the page keeps running) show as a warning
